title: All Aboard
tagline: Embedded Wallet introduction to blockchain and rewarded with a slideshow of memes to celebrate
description: I combined the technology provided by frog.fm and dynamic.xyz to create an easy way for people to be introduced to the world of blockchain by automatically making a wallet when they register on the frame. Then, to celebrate thiis, they are shown a slideshow of top quality memes similar to twitter threads but only memes
how_its_made: Combining the frog.fm frame creation and dynamic.xyz embedded wallet tutorials initiialy. Then adding lots of actions and other frames which were really easy to add and all i had to do was to find memes on the internet. I don't know whether this is particularly useful but i wanted to experiment with a sort of amusing presentation and remiinds me of tiktok.
